header: The saved last good answer of a live card (table public.live_snapshot, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/25_live_snapshot.sql): one row for each card that asks for it, holding the whole answer as it was last had from its source and the time it was received. When the source does not answer AND the server's memory is empty (a restart, a new instance, a night of silence), I show this on the card, marked stale with its own time, instead of an error. A card opts in (liveRoute's `persist`); today the gold card does. Nothing here may break a card: database trouble is logged once and the store then answers "nothing saved" (get) or does nothing (put), like marketStore.ts, whose pattern I follow. Nothing in it is personal data.

behaviours: nothing saved: get answers null, and the table is made once
an answer written is read back with its time
a second answer replaces the first (one row for each key)
a row that is not the shape written is dropped, never shown
database trouble never breaks the card: no table and no permission, the store answers 'nothing saved' and writes nothing
a failing read or write is swallowed
the empty store holds nothing
a fresh answer is shown and saved
the source fails and the memory is empty (a restart): the saved answer is shown, marked stale, with the time it was received
a saved answer that is not the shape the card draws is never shown: a plain failure (503)
nothing saved and nothing in memory: a plain failure (503), as before
a database that fails never fails the card (the fresh answer is still shown)
the guard accepts a real parsed answer and refuses a broken one
the gold route keeps its last good answer (it opts in, with the guard)
an empty server takes the saved copy: answered at once from it (nothing built), with the time it was saved, and not written back
a copy older than the three hours an old answer may be served is not taken: the tab is built, and the new one is saved
a copy that is not the shape expected is not taken
what the server already keeps is never replaced by the saved copy
many asking together read the database once for the key
no database: the tab is simply built (the card never fails because of its saved copy)
a card with serve-then-refresh does not wait for the write of its saved copy (it is handed to the host to finish)
the news route saves and seeds its tabs (looksLikeNewsAnswer, seed), and warms the other four after answering, two at a time, at most every 20 seconds, with the same options as serving
